      --- market kline service/router ---
      import { Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
      import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
      import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
      import { D1PrismaService } from '../d1/d1-prisma.service';
      import { MarketKlineInput, normalizeMarketKline } from './market-kline.contract';
      
      export interface MarketQuoteCandleInput {
        symbol: string;
        price: string | number;
        provider: string;
        source: string;
        observedAt: Date;
      }
      
      @Injectable()
      export class MarketKlineService {
        private get db(): any { return this.d1.isEnabled() ? this.d1 : this.prisma; }
      
        constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService, private readonly d1: D1PrismaService) {}
      
        async list(symbol: string, interval: string, limit: number, from?: Date, to?: Date) {
          const normalizedSymbol = symbol.trim().toUpperCase().replaceAll('/', '');
          const pair = await this.db.marketPair.findUnique({ where: { symbol: normalizedSymbol } });
          if (!pair) return [];
          const rows = await this.db.marketKline.findMany({
            where: {
              pairId: pair.id,
              interval,
              ...(from || to ? { openTime: { ...(from ? { gte: from } : {}), ...(to ? { lte: to } : {}) } } : {}),
            },
            // Select the newest candles before applying the limit. Ordering ascending
            // here would return the oldest window and make a healthy live stream look
            // stale whenever historical rows outnumber the requested limit.
            orderBy: { openTime: 'desc' },
            take: limit,
          });
          return rows.reverse().map((row) => this.toContract(row));
        }
      
        async persist(input: MarketKlineInput) {
          const normalized = normalizeMarketKline(input);
          const pair = await this.db.marketPair.findUnique({ where: { symbol: normalized.symbol } });
          if (!pair) throw new NotFoundException(`Market pair ${normalized.symbol} is not configured`);
          const existing = await this.db.marketKline.findUnique({
            where: { pairId_interval_openTime: { pairId: pair.id, interval: normalized.interval, openTime: normalized.openTime } },
          });
          if (existing && existing.observedAt.getTime() > normalized.observedAt.getTime()) return this.toContract(existing);
          const row = await this.db.marketKline.upsert({
            where: { pairId_interval_openTime: { pairId: pair.id, interval: normalized.interval, openTime: normalized.openTime } },
            update: {
              closeTime: normalized.closeTime,
              open: normalized.open,
              high: normalized.high,
              low: normalized.low,
              close: normalized.close,
              volume: normalized.volume,
              provider: normalized.provider,
              source: normalized.source,
              observedAt: normalized.observedAt,
            },
            create: {
              pairId: pair.id,
              symbol: normalized.symbol,
              interval: normalized.interval,
              openTime: normalized.openTime,
              closeTime: normalized.closeTime,
              open: normalized.open,
              high: normalized.high,
              low: normalized.low,
              close: normalized.close,
              volume: normalized.volume,
              provider: normalized.provider,
              source: normalized.source,
              observedAt: normalized.observedAt,
            },
          });
          return this.toContract(row);
        }
      
        /**
         * Builds the active one-minute OHLC candle from already-authoritative
         * provider quotes. Volume remains null because a ticker's 24h volume is not
         * a candle volume and must not be presented as one.
         */
        async accumulateQuote(input: MarketQuoteCandleInput) {
          const source = input.source.trim();
          if (!source) throw new Error('Market quote candle source is required');
          const openTime = new Date(Math.floor(input.observedAt.getTime() / 60_000) * 60_000);
          const candidate = normalizeMarketKline({
            symbol: input.symbol,
            interval: '1m',
            openTime,
            closeTime: input.observedAt,
            open: input.price,
            high: input.price,
            low: input.price,
            close: input.price,
            volume: null,
            provider: input.provider,
            source: `${source}:quote-aggregation`,
            observedAt: input.observedAt,
          });
          const pair = await this.db.marketPair.findUnique({ where: { symbol: candidate.symbol } });
          if (!pair) throw new NotFoundException(`Market pair ${candidate.symbol} is not configured`);
      
          const existing = await this.db.marketKline.findUnique({
            where: { pairId_interval_openTime: { pairId: pair.id, interval: candidate.interval, openTime } },
          });
          if (!existing) {
            return this.db.marketKline.create({
              data: {
                pairId: pair.id,
                symbol: candidate.symbol,
                interval: candidate.interval,
                openTime,
                closeTime: candidate.closeTime,
                open: candidate.open,
                high: candidate.high,
                low: candidate.low,
                close: candidate.close,
                volume: null,
                provider: candidate.provider,
                source: candidate.source,
                observedAt: candidate.observedAt,
              },
            });
          }
      
          // A late provider message must not regress the current close or freshness.
          if (existing.observedAt.getTime() > candidate.observedAt.getTime()) return existing;
          return this.db.marketKline.update({
            where: { id: existing.id },
            data: {
              closeTime: candidate.closeTime,
              high: existing.high.gt(candidate.high) ? existing.high : candidate.high,
              low: existing.low.lt(candidate.low) ? existing.low : candidate.low,
              close: candidate.close,
              // Provider ticker volume is 24h aggregate data, not per-candle volume.
              volume: null,
              provider: candidate.provider,
              source: candidate.source,
              observedAt: candidate.observedAt,
            },
          });
        }
      
        private toContract(row: {
          symbol: string; interval: string; openTime: Date; closeTime: Date | null;
          open: Prisma.Decimal; high: Prisma.Decimal; low: Prisma.Decimal; close: Prisma.Decimal;
          volume: Prisma.Decimal | null; provider: string; source: string; observedAt: Date; receivedAt: Date;
        }) {
          return {
            time: Math.floor(row.openTime.getTime() / 1000),
            open: row.open.toString(),
            high: row.high.toString(),
            low: row.low.toString(),
            close: row.close.toString(),
            volume: row.volume?.toString() ?? null,
            symbol: row.symbol,
            interval: row.interval,
            closeTime: row.closeTime?.toISOString() ?? null,
            provider: row.provider,
            source: row.source,
            observedAt: row.observedAt.toISOString(),
            receivedAt: row.receivedAt.toISOString(),
          };
        }
      }
      import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
      import { BinanceSpotAdapter } from './binance-spot.adapter';
      import { MarketProviderAdapter, MarketProviderEvent, MarketProviderRuntimeSymbol } from './market-provider.adapter';
      import type { MarketKlineInput, MarketKlineInterval } from './market-kline.contract';
      import { D1PrismaService } from '../d1/d1-prisma.service';
      import { getMarketSourcePolicy, getProviderMapping, installRuntimeProviderMappings } from './market-source-registry';
      import { MetalsApiMarketAdapter } from './metals-api-market.adapter';
      import { MetalpriceApiMarketAdapter } from './metalprice-api-market.adapter';
      import { OandaMarketAdapter } from './oanda-market.adapter';
      import { FawazCurrencyMarketAdapter } from './fawaz-currency-market.adapter';
      import { RzzroIndustrialMetalsMarketAdapter } from './rzzro-industrial-metals-market.adapter';
      import { YahooMarketAdapter } from './yahoo-market.adapter';
      import { BiquoteMarketAdapter } from './biquote-market.adapter';
      import { MoexUsdRubAdapter } from './moex-usdrub.adapter';
      import { CoinGeckoMarketAdapter } from './coingecko-market.adapter';
      import { CoinMarketCapMarketAdapter } from './coinmarketcap-market.adapter';
      import { OkxMarketAdapter, BitgetMarketAdapter, HtxMarketAdapter, BybitMarketAdapter, GateMarketAdapter } from './public-exchange-market.adapter';
      
      @Injectable()
      export class MarketProviderRouterService {
        private readonly logger = new Logger(MarketProviderRouterService.name);
        private readonly adapters: readonly MarketProviderAdapter[];
        private readonly activeProviders = new Set<string>();
      
        constructor(
          binance: BinanceSpotAdapter,
          oanda: OandaMarketAdapter,
          metalsApi: MetalsApiMarketAdapter,
          metalpriceApi: MetalpriceApiMarketAdapter,
          fawazCurrency: FawazCurrencyMarketAdapter,
          rzzroIndustrialMetals: RzzroIndustrialMetalsMarketAdapter,
          yahoo: YahooMarketAdapter,
          biquote: BiquoteMarketAdapter,
          moex: MoexUsdRubAdapter,
          coingecko: CoinGeckoMarketAdapter,
          coinmarketcap: CoinMarketCapMarketAdapter,
          okx: OkxMarketAdapter,
          bitget: BitgetMarketAdapter,
          htx: HtxMarketAdapter,
          bybit: BybitMarketAdapter,
          gate: GateMarketAdapter,
          private readonly d1: D1PrismaService,
        ) {
          this.adapters = [binance, moex, biquote, yahoo, coingecko, coinmarketcap, oanda, metalsApi, metalpriceApi, fawazCurrency, rzzroIndustrialMetals, okx, bitget, htx, bybit, gate];
        }
      
        async start(onEvent: (event: MarketProviderEvent) => void): Promise<boolean> {
          const runtimePolicy = await this.loadRuntimePolicy();
          const configured = runtimePolicy.size > 0 ? [...runtimePolicy.keys()] : this.configuredProviders();
          const selected = this.adapters.filter((adapter) => configured.includes(adapter.provider));
          if (selected.length === 0) {
            this.logger.warn(`Configured market provider is unsupported or missing: ${configured.join(', ') || 'missing'}.`);
            return false;
          }
          let started = false;
          for (const adapter of selected) {
            const symbols = runtimePolicy.get(adapter.provider);
            if (symbols) adapter.configure?.(symbols);
            if (!adapter.isEnabled()) continue;
            await adapter.start(onEvent);
            this.activeProviders.add(adapter.provider);
            started = true;
          }
          this.logger.log(`Active market providers: ${[...this.activeProviders].join(', ') || 'none'}.`);
          return started;
        }
      
        async fetchHistory(symbol: string, interval: MarketKlineInterval, limit: number): Promise<MarketKlineInput[]> {
          const normalized = symbol.trim().toUpperCase().replaceAll('/', '');
          const candidates = await this.historyCandidates(normalized);
          for (const provider of candidates) {
            const adapter = this.adapters.find((candidate) => candidate.provider === provider);
            const mapping = getProviderMapping(normalized, provider);
            if (!adapter?.fetchHistory || !mapping?.klineSupported) continue;
            try {
              const rows = await adapter.fetchHistory(normalized, interval, limit);
              if (rows.length > 0) {
                this.logger.log(`Market history ${normalized} ${interval}: ${rows.length} row(s) from ${provider}.`);
                return rows;
              }
            } catch (error) {
              this.logger.warn(`Market history ${normalized} ${interval} failed via ${provider}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'unknown error'}`);
            }
          }
          return [];
        }
      
        private async historyCandidates(symbol: string): Promise<string[]> {
          if (this.d1.isEnabled()) {
            try {
              const providers = await this.d1.marketProviderConfig.findMany({
                where: { status: 'ACTIVE', supportsKlines: true },
                orderBy: [{ priority: 'asc' }, { key: 'asc' }],
                include: {
                  symbols: {
                    where: { enabled: true },
                    orderBy: { priority: 'asc' },
                    include: { pair: { select: { symbol: true, status: true } } },
                  },
                },
              });
              return providers
                .flatMap((provider) => provider.symbols
                  .filter((mapping) => mapping.pair.status === 'ACTIVE' && mapping.pair.symbol === symbol)
                  .map((mapping) => ({ provider: provider.key, mappingPriority: mapping.priority, providerPriority: provider.priority })))
                .sort((a, b) => a.mappingPriority - b.mappingPriority || a.providerPriority - b.providerPriority || a.provider.localeCompare(b.provider))
                .map((entry) => entry.provider);
            } catch (error) {
              this.logger.warn(`D1 market history policy load failed for ${symbol}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'unknown error'}`);
            }
          }
          return getMarketSourcePolicy(symbol)?.providerMappings
            .filter((mapping) => mapping.klineSupported)
            .map((mapping) => mapping.provider) ?? [];
        }
      
        stop(): void {
          for (const adapter of this.adapters) adapter.stop();
          this.activeProviders.clear();
        }
      
        isProviderEnabled(provider?: string | null): boolean {
          if (!provider) return false;
          if (this.activeProviders.size > 0) return this.activeProviders.has(provider.trim().toLowerCase());
          return this.configuredProviders().includes(provider.trim().toLowerCase());
        }
      
        private configuredProviders(): string[] {
          const multi = process.env.MARKET_PROVIDER_NAMES?.split(',').map((value) => value.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean) ?? [];
          const legacy = process.env.MARKET_PROVIDER_NAME?.trim().toLowerCase();
          return [...new Set(multi.length ? multi : legacy ? [legacy] : [])];
        }
      
        private async loadRuntimePolicy(): Promise<Map<string, MarketProviderRuntimeSymbol[]>> {
          if (!this.d1.isEnabled()) return new Map();
          try {
            const providers = await this.d1.marketProviderConfig.findMany({
              where: { status: 'ACTIVE', supportsQuotes: true },
              orderBy: [{ priority: 'asc' }, { key: 'asc' }],
              include: {
                symbols: {
                  where: { enabled: true },
                  orderBy: { priority: 'asc' },
                  include: { pair: { select: { symbol: true, status: true } } },
                },
              },
            });
            const allMappings: Array<{ symbol: string; provider: string; providerInstrument: string }> = [];
            const bySymbol = new Map<string, Array<{ provider: string; symbol: string; providerInstrument: string; mappingPriority: number; providerPriority: number }>>();
            for (const provider of providers) {
              for (const mapping of provider.symbols) {
                if (mapping.pair.status !== 'ACTIVE') continue;
                const staticMapping = getMarketSourcePolicy(mapping.pair.symbol)?.providerMappings
                  .find((candidate) => candidate.provider === provider.key);
                if (!staticMapping?.quoteSupported) continue;
                const entry = {
                  provider: provider.key,
                  symbol: mapping.pair.symbol,
                  providerInstrument: mapping.providerSymbol,
                  mappingPriority: mapping.priority,
                  providerPriority: provider.priority,
                };
                allMappings.push(entry);
                const existing = bySymbol.get(entry.symbol) ?? [];
                existing.push(entry);
                bySymbol.set(entry.symbol, existing);
              }
            }
            installRuntimeProviderMappings(allMappings);
      
            const selected = new Map<string, MarketProviderRuntimeSymbol[]>();
            for (const entries of bySymbol.values()) {
              entries.sort((a, b) => a.mappingPriority - b.mappingPriority || a.providerPriority - b.providerPriority || a.provider.localeCompare(b.provider));
              for (const entry of entries.slice(0, 2)) {
                const symbols = selected.get(entry.provider) ?? [];
                symbols.push({ symbol: entry.symbol, providerInstrument: entry.providerInstrument });
                selected.set(entry.provider, symbols);
              }
            }
            this.logger.log(`Loaded D1 market policy: ${allMappings.length} callable mapping(s), ${selected.size} active provider(s).`);
            return selected;
          } catch (error) {
            this.logger.warn(`D1 market policy load failed; using bootstrap provider configuration: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'unknown error'}`);
            return new Map();
          }
        }
      }

      import {
        Body,
        Controller,
        Get,
        Param,
        Patch,
        Post,
        Request,
        ServiceUnavailableException,
        UnauthorizedException,
        UseGuards,
      } from "@nestjs/common";
      import { ApiTags } from "@nestjs/swagger";
      import { AuthService } from "./auth.service";
      import { JwtAuthGuard } from "./jwt-auth.guard";
      import { AuthenticatedRequest } from "./auth.types";
      import {
        LoginDto,
        RefreshTokenDto,
        SignupDto,
        UpdatePreferencesDto,
        UpdateProfileDto,
        WalletChallengeDto,
        WalletVerifyDto,
      } from "./auth.dto";
      import { AuthRateLimit } from "./auth-rate-limit.decorator";
      import { AuthRateLimitGuard } from "./auth-rate-limit.guard";
      import { AuthSurfaceGuard } from "./auth-surface.guard";
      import { RequireAuthSurface } from "./auth-surface.decorator";
      import { WalletAuthService } from "./wallet-auth.service";
      
      @ApiTags("Authentication")
      @Controller("auth")
      export class AuthController {
        constructor(
          private authService: AuthService,
          private walletAuthService?: WalletAuthService,
        ) {}
      
        @Post("login")
        @AuthRateLimit("login")
        @UseGuards(AuthRateLimitGuard)
        async login(@Body() credentials: LoginDto) {
          const user = await this.authService.validateUser(credentials);
          if (!user) {
            throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid credentials");
          }
          return this.authService.login(user);
        }
      
        @Post("signup")
        @AuthRateLimit("signup")
        @UseGuards(AuthRateLimitGuard)
        async signup(@Body() data: SignupDto) {
          return this.authService.signup(data);
        }
      
        @Post("wallet/challenge")
        async walletChallenge(@Body() body: WalletChallengeDto) {
          if (!this.walletAuthService)
            throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
              "Wallet authentication is unavailable",
            );
          return this.walletAuthService.createChallenge(body);
        }
      
        @Post("wallet/verify")
        async walletVerify(
          @Body() body: WalletVerifyDto,
          @Request()
          request: { headers?: Record<string, string | undefined>; ip?: string },
        ) {
          if (!this.walletAuthService)
            throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
              "Wallet authentication is unavailable",
            );
          return this.walletAuthService.verifyChallenge(body, {
            userAgent: request.headers?.["user-agent"],
            ip: request.ip,
          });
        }
      
        @Get("me")
        @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, AuthSurfaceGuard)
        @RequireAuthSurface("PUBLIC")
        async me(@Request() request: AuthenticatedRequest) {
          if (!this.walletAuthService)
            throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
              "Wallet authentication is unavailable",
            );
          return this.walletAuthService.getCurrentUser(request.user.userId);
        }
      
        @Patch("me")
        @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, AuthSurfaceGuard)
        @RequireAuthSurface("PUBLIC")
        async updateMe(@Request() request: AuthenticatedRequest, @Body() body: UpdateProfileDto) {
          await this.authService.updateProfile(request.user.userId, body);
          if (!this.walletAuthService) throw new ServiceUnavailableException("Wallet authentication is unavailable");
          return this.walletAuthService.getCurrentUser(request.user.userId);
        }
      
        @Get("preferences")
        @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, AuthSurfaceGuard)
        @RequireAuthSurface("PUBLIC")
        async preferences(@Request() request: AuthenticatedRequest) {
          return this.authService.getPreferences(request.user.userId);
        }
      
        @Patch("preferences")
        @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, AuthSurfaceGuard)
        @RequireAuthSurface("PUBLIC")
        async updatePreferences(@Request() request: AuthenticatedRequest, @Body() body: UpdatePreferencesDto) {
          return this.authService.updatePreferences(request.user.userId, body);
        }
      
        @Get("sessions")
        @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, AuthSurfaceGuard)
        @RequireAuthSurface("PUBLIC")
        async sessions(@Request() request: AuthenticatedRequest) {
          return this.authService.listSessions(request.user);
        }
      
        @Post("sessions/:sessionId/revoke")
        @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, AuthSurfaceGuard)
        @RequireAuthSurface("PUBLIC")
        async revokeSession(@Request() request: AuthenticatedRequest, @Param("sessionId") sessionId: string) {
          return this.authService.revokeSession(request.user, sessionId);
        }
      
        @Post("refresh")
        @AuthRateLimit("refresh")
        @UseGuards(AuthRateLimitGuard)
        async refresh(@Body() body: RefreshTokenDto) {
          return this.authService.refresh(body.refreshToken, "PUBLIC");
        }
      
        @Post("logout")
        @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, AuthSurfaceGuard)
        @RequireAuthSurface("PUBLIC")
        async logout(@Request() request: AuthenticatedRequest) {
          return this.authService.logout(request.user);
        }
      
        @Post("logout-all")
        @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, AuthSurfaceGuard)
        @RequireAuthSurface("PUBLIC")
        async logoutAll(@Request() request: AuthenticatedRequest) {
          return this.authService.logoutAll(request.user);
        }
      
        // @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
        // @Get('profile')
        // getProfile(@Request() req) {
        //   return req.user;
        // }
      }

      export const MARKET_KLINE_INTERVALS = [
        '1m', '3m', '5m', '15m', '30m', '1h', '2h', '4h', '6h', '8h', '12h', '1d', '3d', '1w', '1M',

      export type MarketKlineInterval = (typeof MARKET_KLINE_INTERVALS)[number];
      
      export interface MarketKlineInput {
        symbol: string;
        interval: MarketKlineInterval;
        openTime: Date;
        closeTime?: Date;
        open: string | number;
        high: string | number;
        low: string | number;
        close: string | number;
        volume?: string | number | null;
        provider: string;
        source: string;
        observedAt: Date;
      }
      
      export interface NormalizedMarketKline extends Omit<MarketKlineInput, 'open' | 'high' | 'low' | 'close' | 'volume'> {
        open: Prisma.Decimal;
        high: Prisma.Decimal;
        low: Prisma.Decimal;
        close: Prisma.Decimal;
        volume: Prisma.Decimal | null;
      }
      
      export function normalizeMarketKline(input: MarketKlineInput): NormalizedMarketKline {
        const symbol = input.symbol.trim().toUpperCase().replaceAll('/', '');
        if (!/^[A-Z0-9]{4,24}$/.test(symbol)) throw new Error('Market kline symbol is invalid');
        if (!MARKET_KLINE_INTERVALS.includes(input.interval)) throw new Error('Market kline interval is invalid');
        if (!input.openTime || Number.isNaN(input.openTime.getTime())) throw new Error('Market kline openTime is invalid');
        if (!input.observedAt || Number.isNaN(input.observedAt.getTime())) throw new Error('Market kline observedAt is invalid');
        const open = decimal(input.open, 'open');
        const high = decimal(input.high, 'high');
        const low = decimal(input.low, 'low');
        const close = decimal(input.close, 'close');
        if (high.lt(open) || high.lt(close)) throw new Error('Market kline high must cover open and close');
        if (low.gt(open) || low.gt(close)) throw new Error('Market kline low must be below open and close');
        const volume = input.volume === undefined || input.volume === null ? null : decimal(input.volume, 'volume', true);
        return { ...input, symbol, open, high, low, close, volume };
      }

        if (!result.isFinite() || result.isNegative() || (!allowZero && result.isZero())) {
          throw new Error(`Market kline ${field} must be ${allowZero ? 'non-negative' : 'positive'}`);
        }
        return result;
      }

      interface AuthRateLimitPolicy {
        readonly ipLimit: number;
        readonly accountLimit: number;
        readonly windowSeconds: number;
      }
      
      const AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_POLICIES: Record<AuthRateLimitOperation, AuthRateLimitPolicy> = {
        login: { ipLimit: 20, accountLimit: 5, windowSeconds: 60 },
        signup: { ipLimit: 10, accountLimit: 3, windowSeconds: 60 },
        'admin-login': { ipLimit: 10, accountLimit: 3, windowSeconds: 60 },
        refresh: { ipLimit: 20, accountLimit: 5, windowSeconds: 60 },
        'admin-refresh': { ipLimit: 10, accountLimit: 3, windowSeconds: 60 },
      };
      
      export class AuthRateLimitExceededException extends HttpException {
        constructor() {
          super('Too many authentication attempts', HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS);
        }
      }
      
      @Injectable()
      export class AuthRateLimitGuard implements CanActivate {
        constructor(
          private readonly reflector: Reflector,
          private readonly rateLimiter: RedisRateLimitService,
        ) {}
      
        async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> {
          const operation = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<AuthRateLimitOperation>(AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_OPERATION, [
            context.getHandler(),
            context.getClass(),
          ]) ?? 'login';
          const policy = AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_POLICIES[operation];
          const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest<AuthRateLimitRequest>();
          const keys = [
            {
              key: `auth:${operation}:ip:${this.digest(request.ip || 'unknown')}`,
              limit: policy.ipLimit,
            },
          ];
          const email = request.body?.email;
          if (typeof email === 'string' && email.trim().length > 0) {
            keys.push({
              key: `auth:${operation}:account:${this.digest(email.trim().toLowerCase())}`,
              limit: policy.accountLimit,
            });
          }
          const refreshToken = request.body?.refreshToken;
          if ((operation === 'refresh' || operation === 'admin-refresh') && typeof refreshToken === 'string' && refreshToken.length > 0) {
            keys.push({
              key: `auth:${operation}:token:${this.digest(refreshToken)}`,
              limit: policy.accountLimit,
            });
          }
      
          try {
            for (const candidate of keys) {
              const decision = await this.rateLimiter.consume(candidate.key, candidate.limit, policy.windowSeconds);
              if (!decision.allowed) {
                throw new AuthRateLimitExceededException();
              }
            }
          } catch (error) {
            if (error instanceof AuthRateLimitExceededException) {
              throw error;
            }
            throw new ServiceUnavailableException('Authentication rate limiter unavailable');
          }
      
          return true;
        }
      
        private digest(value: string): string {
          return createHash('sha256').update(value, 'utf8').digest('hex');
        }
      }

      @Injectable()
      export class JwtStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy) {
        constructor(
          config: ConfigService,
          @Optional() private readonly prisma?: PrismaService,
          @Optional() private readonly d1?: D1FinancialCommandGateway,
        ) {
          super({
            jwtFromRequest: ExtractJwt.fromAuthHeaderAsBearerToken(),
            ignoreExpiration: false,
            secretOrKey: config.getOrThrow<string>('JWT_SECRET'),
          });
        }
      
        async validate(payload: JwtPayload): Promise<AuthenticatedUser> {
          const surface = payload?.surface ?? 'PUBLIC';
          if (
            !payload ||
            typeof payload.sub !== 'string' ||
            payload.sub.length === 0 ||
            payload.email !== undefined && payload.email !== null &&
            (typeof payload.email !== 'string' || payload.email.length === 0) ||
            !Object.values(Role).includes(payload.role) ||
            !Object.values<AuthSurface>(['PUBLIC', 'ADMIN']).includes(surface)
          ) {
            throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid authentication claims');
          }
      
          if (payload.sid && (this.d1?.isEnabled() || this.prisma)) {
            try {
              if (this.d1?.isEnabled()) {
                const [session, user] = await Promise.all([
                  this.d1.getAuthSessionById(payload.sid),
                  this.d1.getUserById(payload.sub),
                ]);
                const now = new Date();
                if (!session || !user || user.role !== payload.role || session.userId !== payload.sub || session.surface !== surface || session.revokedAt || now >= new Date(session.absoluteExpiresAt) || now >= new Date(session.idleExpiresAt)) {
                  throw new UnauthorizedException('Authentication session is not active');
                }
              } else if (this.prisma) {
                const [session, user] = await Promise.all([
                  this.prisma.authSession.findUnique({ where: { id: payload.sid } }),
                  this.prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: payload.sub }, select: { role: true } }),
                ]);
                const now = new Date();
                if (!session || !user || user.role !== payload.role || session.userId !== payload.sub || session.surface !== surface || session.revokedAt || now >= session.absoluteExpiresAt || now >= session.idleExpiresAt) {
                  throw new UnauthorizedException('Authentication session is not active');
                }
              }
            } catch (error) {
              if (error instanceof UnauthorizedException) {
                throw error;
              }
              throw new UnauthorizedException('Authentication session could not be validated');
            }
          }
      
          return { userId: payload.sub, email: payload.email, role: payload.role, surface, ...(payload.sid ? { sessionId: payload.sid } : {}) };
        }
      }

      import { Controller, Get, HttpException, HttpStatus } from "@nestjs/common";

      @ApiTags("Operations")
      @Controller("ops")
      export class HealthController {
        constructor(
          private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
          private readonly d1: D1PrismaService,
          private readonly redis: RedisService,
        ) {}
      
        @Get("live")
        live() {
          return { status: "ok", service: "nexi-api" };
        }
      
        @Get("ready")
        async ready() {
          const d1Enabled = process.env.D1_RUNTIME_ENABLED === "true";
          const database = await this.withTimeout(
            d1Enabled ? this.d1.isReady() : this.prisma.isReady(),
            3_000,
          );
          const redis = await this.withTimeout(this.redis.isReady(), 3_000);
          const body = {
            status: database && redis ? "ready" : "not_ready",
            dependencies: { database, redis },
          };
          if (!database || !redis)
            throw new HttpException(body, HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE);
          return body;
        }
      
        private async withTimeout(
          promise: Promise<boolean>,
          timeoutMs: number,
        ): Promise<boolean> {
          let timeoutHandle: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
          const timeout = new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
            timeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => resolve(false), timeoutMs);
          });
          try {
            return await Promise.race([promise, timeout]);
          } finally {
            if (timeoutHandle) clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
          }
        }
      }

    import {
      HttpException,
      HttpStatus,
      Injectable,
      ServiceUnavailableException,
    } from '@nestjs/common';
    import { D1PrismaService } from '../d1/d1-prisma.service';
    import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
    import { RedisService } from '../redis/redis.service';
    
    export type ReadinessReport = {
      database: boolean;
      redis: boolean;
      authority: 'D1' | 'PostgreSQL';
    };
    
    @Injectable()
    export class ReadinessService {
      constructor(
        private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
        private readonly d1: D1PrismaService,
        private readonly redis: RedisService,
      ) {}
    
      async getApplicationReadiness() {
        const report = await this.getReport();
        if (!report.database || !report.redis) {
          throw new ServiceUnavailableException({
            status: 'NOT_READY',
            dependencies: {
              database: report.database,
              redis: report.redis,
              authority: report.authority,
            },
          });
        }
    
        return {
          status: 'READY',
          dependencies: {
            database: report.database,
            redis: report.redis,
            authority: report.authority,
          },
        };
      }
    
      async getOperationalReadiness() {
        const report = await this.getReport();
        const body = {
          status: report.database && report.redis ? 'ready' : 'not_ready',
          dependencies: {
            database: report.database,
            redis: report.redis,
          },
        };
        if (!report.database || !report.redis) {
          throw new HttpException(body, HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE);
        }
        return body;
      }
    
      private async getReport(): Promise<ReadinessReport> {
        const d1Enabled = process.env.D1_RUNTIME_ENABLED === 'true';
        const [database, redis] = await Promise.all([
          this.withTimeout(
            d1Enabled ? this.d1.isReady() : this.prisma.isReady(),
            3_000,
          ),
          this.withTimeout(this.redis.isReady(), 3_000),
        ]);
    
        return {
          database,
          redis,
          authority: d1Enabled ? 'D1' : 'PostgreSQL',
        };
      }
    
      private async withTimeout(
        promise: Promise<boolean>,
        timeoutMs: number,
      ): Promise<boolean> {
        let timeoutHandle: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
        const timeout = new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
          timeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => resolve(false), timeoutMs);
        });
        try {
          return await Promise.race([promise, timeout]);
        } finally {
          if (timeoutHandle) clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
        }
      }
    }

      import { MarketKlineService } from '../../src/market/market-kline.service';
      
      describe('MarketKlineService quote aggregation', () => {
        const disabledD1 = () => ({ isEnabled: jest.fn().mockReturnValue(false) });
      
        const createService = () => {
          const rows = new Map<string, any>();
          const keyFor = (where: any) => {
            const key = where.pairId_interval_openTime;
            return `${key.pairId}:${key.interval}:${key.openTime.toISOString()}`;
          };
          const prisma: any = {
            marketPair: { findUnique: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'pair-btcusdt', symbol: 'BTCUSDT' })) },
            marketKline: {
              findUnique: jest.fn(async ({ where }: any) => rows.get(keyFor(where)) ?? null),
              create: jest.fn(async ({ data }: any) => {
                const row = { id: 'kline-1', ...data, receivedAt: new Date('2026-08-10T00:00:00.000Z') };
                rows.set(`${data.pairId}:${data.interval}:${data.openTime.toISOString()}`, row);
                return row;
              }),
              update: jest.fn(async ({ where, data }: any) => {
                const row = [...rows.values()].find((value) => value.id === where.id);
                const next = { ...row, ...data };
                rows.set(`${next.pairId}:${next.interval}:${next.openTime.toISOString()}`, next);
                return next;
              }),
            },
          };
          return { service: new MarketKlineService(prisma, disabledD1() as never), prisma };
        };
      
        it('creates a 1m candle from a provider quote with explicit derived lineage and no fabricated volume', async () => {
          const { service, prisma } = createService();
      
          await (service as any).accumulateQuote({
            symbol: 'BTC/USDT',
            price: '30000',
            provider: 'provider-a',
            source: 'websocket',
            observedAt: new Date('2026-08-10T12:34:56.789Z'),
          });
      
          const data = prisma.marketKline.create.mock.calls[0][0].data;
          expect(data.openTime.toISOString()).toBe('2026-08-10T12:34:00.000Z');
          expect(data.open.toString()).toBe('30000');
          expect(data.high.toString()).toBe('30000');
          expect(data.low.toString()).toBe('30000');
          expect(data.close.toString()).toBe('30000');
          expect(data.volume).toBeNull();
          expect(data.source).toBe('websocket:quote-aggregation');
        });

      import { Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
      import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
      import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
      import { D1PrismaService } from '../d1/d1-prisma.service';
      import { MarketKlineInput, normalizeMarketKline } from './market-kline.contract';
      
      export interface MarketQuoteCandleInput {
        symbol: string;
        price: string | number;
        provider: string;
        source: string;
        observedAt: Date;
      }
      
      @Injectable()
      export class MarketKlineService {
        private get db(): any { return this.d1.isEnabled() ? this.d1 : this.prisma; }
      
        constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService, private readonly d1: D1PrismaService) {}
      
        async list(symbol: string, interval: string, limit: number, from?: Date, to?: Date) {
          const normalizedSymbol = symbol.trim().toUpperCase().replaceAll('/', '');
          const pair = await this.db.marketPair.findUnique({ where: { symbol: normalizedSymbol } });
          if (!pair) return [];
          const rows = await this.db.marketKline.findMany({
            where: {
              pairId: pair.id,
              interval,
              ...(from || to ? { openTime: { ...(from ? { gte: from } : {}), ...(to ? { lte: to } : {}) } } : {}),
            },
            // Select the newest candles before applying the limit. Ordering ascending
            // here would return the oldest window and make a healthy live stream look
            // stale whenever historical rows outnumber the requested limit.
            orderBy: { openTime: 'desc' },
            take: limit,
          });
          return rows.reverse().map((row) => this.toContract(row));
        }
      
        async persist(input: MarketKlineInput) {
          const normalized = normalizeMarketKline(input);
          const pair = await this.db.marketPair.findUnique({ where: { symbol: normalized.symbol } });
          if (!pair) throw new NotFoundException(`Market pair ${normalized.symbol} is not configured`);
          const existing = await this.db.marketKline.findUnique({
            where: { pairId_interval_openTime: { pairId: pair.id, interval: normalized.interval, openTime: normalized.openTime } },
          });
          if (existing && existing.observedAt.getTime() > normalized.observedAt.getTime()) return this.toContract(existing);
          const row = await this.db.marketKline.upsert({
            where: { pairId_interval_openTime: { pairId: pair.id, interval: normalized.interval, openTime: normalized.openTime } },
            update: {
              closeTime: normalized.closeTime,
              open: normalized.open,
              high: normalized.high,
              low: normalized.low,
              close: normalized.close,
              volume: normalized.volume,
              provider: normalized.provider,
              source: normalized.source,
              observedAt: normalized.observedAt,
            },
            create: {
              pairId: pair.id,
              symbol: normalized.symbol,
              interval: normalized.interval,
              openTime: normalized.openTime,
              closeTime: normalized.closeTime,
              open: normalized.open,
              high: normalized.high,
              low: normalized.low,
              close: normalized.close,
              volume: normalized.volume,
              provider: normalized.provider,
              source: normalized.source,
              observedAt: normalized.observedAt,
            },
          });
          return this.toContract(row);
        }
      
        /**
         * Builds the active one-minute OHLC candle from already-authoritative
         * provider quotes. Volume remains null because a ticker's 24h volume is not
         * a candle volume and must not be presented as one.
         */
        async accumulateQuote(input: MarketQuoteCandleInput) {
          const source = input.source.trim();
          if (!source) throw new Error('Market quote candle source is required');
          const openTime = new Date(Math.floor(input.observedAt.getTime() / 60_000) * 60_000);
          const candidate = normalizeMarketKline({
            symbol: input.symbol,
            interval: '1m',
            openTime,
            closeTime: input.observedAt,
            open: input.price,
            high: input.price,
            low: input.price,
            close: input.price,
            volume: null,
            provider: input.provider,
            source: `${source}:quote-aggregation`,
            observedAt: input.observedAt,
          });
          const pair = await this.db.marketPair.findUnique({ where: { symbol: candidate.symbol } });
          if (!pair) throw new NotFoundException(`Market pair ${candidate.symbol} is not configured`);
      
          const existing = await this.db.marketKline.findUnique({
            where: { pairId_interval_openTime: { pairId: pair.id, interval: candidate.interval, openTime } },
          });
          if (!existing) {
            return this.db.marketKline.create({
              data: {
                pairId: pair.id,
                symbol: candidate.symbol,
                interval: candidate.interval,
                openTime,
                closeTime: candidate.closeTime,
                open: candidate.open,
                high: candidate.high,
                low: candidate.low,
                close: candidate.close,
                volume: null,
                provider: candidate.provider,
                source: candidate.source,
                observedAt: candidate.observedAt,
              },
            });
          }
      
          // A late provider message must not regress the current close or freshness.
          if (existing.observedAt.getTime() > candidate.observedAt.getTime()) return existing;
          return this.db.marketKline.update({
            where: { id: existing.id },
            data: {
              closeTime: candidate.closeTime,
              high: existing.high.gt(candidate.high) ? existing.high : candidate.high,
              low: existing.low.lt(candidate.low) ? existing.low : candidate.low,
              close: candidate.close,
              // Provider ticker volume is 24h aggregate data, not per-candle volume.
              volume: null,
              provider: candidate.provider,
              source: candidate.source,
              observedAt: candidate.observedAt,
            },
          });
        }
      
        private toContract(row: {
          symbol: string; interval: string; openTime: Date; closeTime: Date | null;
          open: Prisma.Decimal; high: Prisma.Decimal; low: Prisma.Decimal; close: Prisma.Decimal;
          volume: Prisma.Decimal | null; provider: string; source: string; observedAt: Date; receivedAt: Date;
        }) {
          return {
            time: Math.floor(row.openTime.getTime() / 1000),
            open: row.open.toString(),
            high: row.high.toString(),
            low: row.low.toString(),
            close: row.close.toString(),
            volume: row.volume?.toString() ?? null,
            symbol: row.symbol,
            interval: row.interval,
            closeTime: row.closeTime?.toISOString() ?? null,
            provider: row.provider,
            source: row.source,
            observedAt: row.observedAt.toISOString(),
            receivedAt: row.receivedAt.toISOString(),
          };
        }
      }

    import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
    import { MarketKlineQueryDto } from './market-kline.dto';
    import { MarketKlineService } from './market-kline.service';
    import { MarketProviderRouterService } from './market-provider-router.service';
    
    @Injectable()
    export class MarketKlineQueryService {
      private readonly logger = new Logger(MarketKlineQueryService.name);
    
      constructor(
        private readonly klines: MarketKlineService,
        private readonly providers: MarketProviderRouterService,
      ) {}
    
      async list(query: MarketKlineQueryDto) {
        const symbol = query.symbol.replaceAll('/', '').toUpperCase();
        let candles = await this.klines.list(
          symbol,
          query.interval,
          query.limit,
          query.from ? new Date(query.from) : undefined,
          query.to ? new Date(query.to) : undefined,
        );
    
        // Hydrate only a missing bounded window. Startup does not need a large
        // backfill, but a first chart request must be able to reach the selected
        // provider and persist canonical candles in D1 before returning them.
        if (candles.length === 0 && !query.from && !query.to) {
          try {
            const history = await this.providers.fetchHistory(
              symbol,
              query.interval,
              query.limit,
            );
            for (const candle of history) await this.klines.persist(candle);
            if (history.length > 0) {
              candles = await this.klines.list(
                symbol,
                query.interval,
                query.limit,
              );
            }
          } catch (error) {
            this.logger.warn(
              `Market history hydration failed for ${symbol} ${query.interval}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'unknown error'}`,
            );
          }
        }
    
        const newest = candles.at(-1)?.observedAt
          ? new Date(candles.at(-1)!.observedAt).getTime()
          : 0;
        const staleAfterMs = Number(
          process.env.MARKET_QUOTE_STALE_AFTER_MS ?? '30000',
        );
        const dataState =
          candles.length === 0
            ? 'UNAVAILABLE'
            : Date.now() - newest <= staleAfterMs
              ? 'LIVE'
              : 'STALE';
    
        return {
          dataState,
          symbol,
          interval: query.interval,
          candles,
          observedAt: candles.at(-1)?.observedAt ?? null,
          message:
            candles.length > 0
              ? undefined
              : 'Authoritative market candles are unavailable.',
        };
      }
    }

        constructor(
          private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
          private readonly d1: D1PrismaService,
          private readonly redis: RedisService,
        ) {}
      
        async getApplicationReadiness() {
          const report = await this.getReport();
          if (!report.database || !report.redis) {
            throw new ServiceUnavailableException({
              status: 'NOT_READY',
              dependencies: {
                database: report.database,
                redis: report.redis,
                authority: report.authority,
              },
            });
          }
      
          return {
            status: 'READY',
            dependencies: {
              database: report.database,
              redis: report.redis,
              authority: report.authority,
            },
          };
        }
      
        async getOperationalReadiness() {
          const report = await this.getReport();
          const body = {
            status: report.database && report.redis ? 'ready' : 'not_ready',
            dependencies: {
              database: report.database,
              redis: report.redis,
            },
          };
          if (!report.database || !report.redis) {
            throw new HttpException(body, HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE);
          }
          return body;
        }
      
        private async getReport(): Promise<ReadinessReport> {
          const d1Enabled = process.env.D1_RUNTIME_ENABLED === 'true';
          const [database, redis] = await Promise.all([
            this.withTimeout(
              d1Enabled ? this.d1.isReady() : this.prisma.isReady(),
              3_000,
            ),
            this.withTimeout(this.redis.isReady(), 3_000),
          ]);
      
          return {
            database,
            redis,
            authority: d1Enabled ? 'D1' : 'PostgreSQL',
          };
        }
      
        private async withTimeout(
          promise: Promise<boolean>,
          timeoutMs: number,
        ): Promise<boolean> {
          let timeoutHandle: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
          const timeout = new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
            timeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => resolve(false), timeoutMs);
          });
          try {
            return await Promise.race([promise, timeout]);
          } finally {
            if (timeoutHandle) clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
          }
        }
      }
      import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
      import { MarketKlineQueryDto } from './market-kline.dto';
      import { MarketKlineService } from './market-kline.service';
      import { MarketProviderRouterService } from './market-provider-router.service';
      
      @Injectable()
      export class MarketKlineQueryService {
        private readonly logger = new Logger(MarketKlineQueryService.name);
      
        constructor(
          private readonly klines: MarketKlineService,
          private readonly providers: MarketProviderRouterService,
        ) {}
      
        async list(query: MarketKlineQueryDto) {
          const symbol = query.symbol.replaceAll('/', '').toUpperCase();
          let candles = await this.klines.list(
            symbol,
            query.interval,
            query.limit,
            query.from ? new Date(query.from) : undefined,
            query.to ? new Date(query.to) : undefined,
          );
      
          // Hydrate only a missing bounded window. Startup does not need a large
          // backfill, but a first chart request must be able to reach the selected
          // provider and persist canonical candles in D1 before returning them.
          if (candles.length === 0 && !query.from && !query.to) {
            try {
              const history = await this.providers.fetchHistory(
                symbol,
                query.interval,
                query.limit,
              );
              for (const candle of history) await this.klines.persist(candle);
              if (history.length > 0) {
                candles = await this.klines.list(
                  symbol,
                  query.interval,
                  query.limit,
                );
              }
            } catch (error) {
              this.logger.warn(
                `Market history hydration failed for ${symbol} ${query.interval}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'unknown error'}`,
              );
            }
          }
      
          const newest = candles.at(-1)?.observedAt
            ? new Date(candles.at(-1)!.observedAt).getTime()
            : 0;
          const staleAfterMs = Number(
            process.env.MARKET_QUOTE_STALE_AFTER_MS ?? '30000',
          );
          const dataState =
            candles.length === 0
              ? 'UNAVAILABLE'
              : Date.now() - newest <= staleAfterMs
                ? 'LIVE'
                : 'STALE';
      
          return {
            dataState,
            symbol,
            interval: query.interval,
            candles,
            observedAt: candles.at(-1)?.observedAt ?? null,
            message:
              candles.length > 0
                ? undefined
                : 'Authoritative market candles are unavailable.',
          };
        }
      }

      description: |
        Extract a URL's content as clean markdown, including JS-rendered pages. Use whenever the user provides a URL and wants its content; prefer over WebFetch.
      allowed-tools:
        - Bash(firecrawl *)
        - Bash(npx firecrawl-cli *)
      ---
      
      # firecrawl scrape
      
      Scrape one or more URLs. Returns clean, LLM-optimized markdown. Multiple URLs are scraped concurrently.
      
      ## Quick start
      
      ```bash
      # Basic markdown extraction
      firecrawl scrape "<url>" -o .firecrawl/page.md
      
      # Main content only, no nav/footer
      firecrawl scrape "<url>" --only-main-content -o .firecrawl/page.md
      
      # Wait for JS to render, then scrape
      firecrawl scrape "<url>" --wait-for 3000 -o .firecrawl/page.md
      
      # Multiple URLs (markdown only; each saved to .firecrawl/; -o is ignored)
      firecrawl scrape https://example.com https://example.com/blog https://example.com/docs
      
      # Get markdown and links together
      firecrawl scrape "<url>" --format markdown,links -o .firecrawl/page.json
      
      # Ask a question about the page
      firecrawl scrape "https://example.com/pricing" --query "What is the enterprise plan price?"
      ```
      
      Run `firecrawl scrape --help` for the full option list.
      
      **Done when:** you have the scraped content — on stdout, in your `-o` file, or under `.firecrawl/` for multi-URL scrapes — and have inspected it with bounded reads (`head`, `grep`) to answer the request.
      
      ## Tips
      
      - **Prefer plain scrape over `--query`.** Scrape to a file, then use `grep`, `head`, or read the markdown directly — you can search and reason over the full content yourself. Use `--query` only when you want a single targeted answer without saving the page (costs 5 extra credits).
      - **Scrape handles static pages and JS-rendered SPAs.** Escalate to `interact` when the page needs interaction (clicks, form fills, pagination) or scrape misses content.
      - Multiple URLs are scraped concurrently — check `firecrawl --status` for your concurrency limit. This mode saves markdown only and ignores `-o`; other requested formats are dropped. If markdown wasn't requested, the whole JSON response is written into the `.md` file.
      - Single format outputs raw content. Multiple formats (e.g., `--format markdown,links`) output JSON.
      - Always quote URLs — shell interprets `?` and `&` as special characters.
      - Naming convention: `.firecrawl/{site}-{path}.md`
      
      ## See also
      
      - [firecrawl-search](../firecrawl-search/SKILL.md) — find pages when you don't have a URL
      - [firecrawl-interact](../firecrawl-interact/SKILL.md) — when scrape can't get the content, use `interact` to click, fill forms, etc.
      - [firecrawl-download](../firecrawl-download/SKILL.md) — bulk download an entire site to local files
      --- firecrawl crawl skill ---
      ---
      name: firecrawl-crawl
      description: |
        Bulk-extract many pages from one site or section. Use for "crawl", "everything under /docs", or content spanning linked pages.
      allowed-tools:
        - Bash(firecrawl *)
        - Bash(npx firecrawl-cli *)
      ---
      
      # firecrawl crawl
      
      Bulk extract content from a website. Crawls pages following links up to a depth/limit.
      
      **Prerequisite:** `crawl` requires authentication (no keyless free tier); without credentials the CLI prompts an interactive login.
      
      ## Quick start
      
      ```bash
      # Crawl a docs section
      firecrawl crawl "<url>" --include-paths /docs --limit 50 --wait -o .firecrawl/crawl.json
      
      # Full crawl with depth limit
      firecrawl crawl "<url>" --max-depth 3 --wait --progress -o .firecrawl/crawl.json
      
      # Check status of a running crawl
      firecrawl crawl <job-id>
      ```
      
      Run `firecrawl crawl --help` for the full option list.
      
      **Done when:** the crawl reaches a terminal status and the saved output under `.firecrawl/` contains the expected pages.
      
      ## Tips
      
      - Use `--wait` when you need the results immediately. It has no default timeout; use `--timeout <seconds>` to bound polling. Without `--wait`, crawl returns a job ID for async polling.
      - **Scope crawls with `--include-paths`** whenever the request names a section — crawl only the pages you need.
      - Crawl consumes credits per page. Check `firecrawl credit-usage` before large crawls (`credit-usage` requires authentication).
      
      ## See also
      
      - [firecrawl-scrape](../firecrawl-scrape/SKILL.md) — scrape individual pages
      - [firecrawl-map](../firecrawl-map/SKILL.md) — discover URLs before deciding to crawl
      - [firecrawl-download](../firecrawl-download/SKILL.md) — download site to local files (uses map + scrape)

      --- OpenAPI generation script ---
      require('ts-node/register/transpile-only');
      
      const { writeFileSync } = require('node:fs');
      const { resolve } = require('node:path');
      const { NestFactory } = require('@nestjs/core');
      const { DocumentBuilder, SwaggerModule } = require('@nestjs/swagger');
      
      process.env.NODE_ENV ??= 'development';
      process.env.DATABASE_URL ??= 'postgresql://openapi-generator.invalid/nexi';
      process.env.REDIS_URL ??= 'redis://openapi-generator.invalid:6379';
      process.env.JWT_SECRET ??= 'openapi-generator-only';
      
      const { AppModule } = require('../src/app.module');
      
      (async () => {
        const app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule, { logger: false });
        const config = new DocumentBuilder()
          .setTitle('NEXI API')
          .setDescription('NEXI application and Admin API contract')
          .setVersion('1.0')
          .addBearerAuth()
          .build();
        const document = SwaggerModule.createDocument(app, config);
        const outputPath = resolve(process.cwd(), '..', 'docs', 'contracts', 'openapi.json');
      
        writeFileSync(outputPath, `${JSON.stringify(document, null, 2)}\n`, 'utf8');
        await app.close();
        console.log(`OpenAPI artifact written to ${outputPath}`);
      })().catch((error) => {
        console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.stack ?? error.message : error);
        process.exitCode = 1;
      });

      ---
      
      # Security and Hardening
      
      ## Overview
      
      Security-first development practices for web applications. Treat every external input as hostile, every secret as sacred, and every authorization check as mandatory. Security isn't a phase — it's a constraint on every line of code that touches user data, authentication, or external systems.
      
      ## When to Use
      
      - Building anything that accepts user input
      - Implementing authentication or authorization
      - Storing or transmitting sensitive data
      - Integrating with external APIs or services
      - Adding file uploads, webhooks, or callbacks
      - Handling payment or PII data
      
      ## Process: Threat Model First
      
      Controls bolted on without a threat model are guesses. Before hardening, spend five minutes thinking like an attacker:
      
      1. **Map the trust boundaries.** Where does untrusted data cross into your system? HTTP requests, form fields, file uploads, webhooks, third-party APIs, message queues, and **LLM output** — plus the local values that look internal because the OS handed them to you: another process's command line or environment, filenames on a shared volume, a path in a job payload. Trust follows who *wrote* a value, not which channel delivered it. Every boundary is attack surface.
      2. **Name the assets.** What's worth stealing or breaking? Credentials, PII, payment data, admin actions, money movement.
      3. **Run STRIDE over each boundary** — a quick lens, not a ceremony:
      
      | Threat | Ask | Typical mitigation |
      |---|---|---|
      | **S**poofing | Can someone impersonate a user/service? | Authentication, signature verification |
      | **T**ampering | Can data be altered in transit or at rest? | Integrity checks, parameterized queries, HTTPS |
      | **R**epudiation | Can an action be denied later? | Audit logging of security events |
      | **I**nformation disclosure | Can data leak? | Encryption, field allowlists, generic errors |
      | **D**enial of service | Can it be overwhelmed? | Rate limiting, input size caps, timeouts |
      | **E**levation of privilege | Can a user gain rights they shouldn't? | Authorization checks, least privilege |
      
      4. **Write abuse cases next to use cases.** For each feature, ask "how would I misuse this?" — then make that your first test.
      
      If you can't name the trust boundaries for a feature, you're not ready to secure it. This is OWASP **A04: Insecure Design** — most breaches begin in design, not code.
      
      ## The Three-Tier Boundary System
      
      ### Always Do (No Exceptions)
      
      - **Validate all external input** at the system boundary (API routes, form handlers)
      - **Parameterize all database queries** — never concatenate user input into SQL
      - **Encode output** to prevent XSS (use framework auto-escaping, don't bypass it)
      - **Use HTTPS** for all external communication
      - **Hash passwords** with bcrypt/scrypt/argon2 (never store plaintext)
      - **Set security headers** (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options)
      - **Use httpOnly, secure, sameSite cookies** for sessions
      - **Run the detected package manager's native audit** against the committed lockfile before every release
      
      ### Ask First (Requires Human Approval)
      
      - Adding new authentication flows or changing auth logic
      - Storing new categories of sensitive data (PII, payment info)
      - Adding new external service integrations
      - Changing CORS configuration
      - Adding file upload handlers
      - Modifying rate limiting or throttling
      - Granting elevated permissions or roles
      
      ### Never Do
      
      - **Never commit secrets** to version control (API keys, passwords, tokens)
      - **Never log sensitive data** (passwords, tokens, full credit card numbers)
      - **Never trust client-side validation** as a security boundary
      - **Never disable security headers** for convenience
      - **Never use `eval()` or `innerHTML`** with user-provided data
      - **Never store sessions in client-accessible storage** (localStorage for auth tokens)
      - **Never expose stack traces** or internal error details to users
      
      ## OWASP Top 10 Prevention Patterns
      
      These are prevention patterns, not a ranking. For the 2021 ordering, see the quick-reference table in `../../references/security-checklist.md`.
      
      ### Injection (SQL, NoSQL, OS Command)
      
      ```typescript
      // BAD: SQL injection via string concatenation
      const query = `SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = '${userId}'`;
      
      // GOOD: Parameterized query
      const user = await db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1', [userId]);
      
      // GOOD: ORM with parameterized input
      const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
      ```
      
      ### Broken Authentication
      
      ```typescript
      // Password hashing
      import { hash, compare } from 'bcrypt';
      
      const SALT_ROUNDS = 12;
      const hashedPassword = await hash(plaintext, SALT_ROUNDS);
      const isValid = await compare(plaintext, hashedPassword);
      
      // Session management
      app.use(session({
        secret: process.env.SESSION_SECRET,  // From environment, not code
        resave: false,
        saveUninitialized: false,
        cookie: {
          httpOnly: true,     // Not accessible via JavaScript
          secure: true,       // HTTPS only
          sameSite: 'lax',    // CSRF protection
          maxAge: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,  // 24 hours
        },
      }));
      ```
      
      ### Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
      
      ```typescript
      // BAD: Rendering user input as HTML
      element.innerHTML = userInput;
      
      // GOOD: Use framework auto-escaping (React does this by default)
      return <div>{userInput}</div>;
      
      // If you MUST render HTML, sanitize first
      import DOMPurify from 'dompurify';
      const clean = DOMPurify.sanitize(userInput);
      ```
      
      ### Broken Access Control
      
      ```typescript
      // Always check authorization, not just authentication
      app.patch('/api/tasks/:id', authenticate, async (req, res) => {
        const task = await taskService.findById(req.params.id);
      
        // Check that the authenticated user owns this resource
        if (task.ownerId !== req.user.id) {
          return res.status(403).json({
            error: { code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Not authorized to modify this task' }
          });
        }
      
        // Proceed with update
        const updated = await taskService.update(req.params.id, req.body);
        return res.json(updated);
      });
      ```
      
      ### Security Misconfiguration
      
      ```typescript
      // Security headers (use helmet for Express)
      import helmet from 'helmet';
      app.use(helmet());
      
      // Content Security Policy
      app.use(helmet.contentSecurityPolicy({
        directives: {
          defaultSrc: ["'self'"],
          scriptSrc: ["'self'"],
          styleSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"],  // Tighten if possible
          imgSrc: ["'self'", 'data:', 'https:'],
          connectSrc: ["'self'"],
        },
      }));
      
      // CORS — restrict to known origins
      app.use(cors({
        origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(',') || 'http://localhost:3000',
        credentials: true,
      }));
      ```
      
      ### Sensitive Data Exposure
      
      ```typescript
      // Never return sensitive fields in API responses
      function sanitizeUser(user: UserRecord): PublicUser {
        const { passwordHash, resetToken, ...publicFields } = user;
        return publicFields;
      }
      
      // Use environment variables for secrets
      const API_KEY = process.env.STRIPE_API_KEY;
      if (!API_KEY) throw new Error('STRIPE_API_KEY not configured');
      ```
      
      ### Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
      
      Any time the server fetches a URL the user influenced — webhooks, "import from URL", image proxies, link previews — an attacker can aim it at internal services (cloud metadata, `localhost`, private IPs).
      
      ```typescript
      // BAD: fetch whatever the user gives you
      await fetch(req.body.webhookUrl);
      
      // GOOD: allowlist scheme + host, reject if ANY resolved IP is private, forbid redirects
      import { lookup } from 'node:dns/promises';
      import ipaddr from 'ipaddr.js';
      
      const ALLOWED_HOSTS = new Set(['hooks.example.com']);
      
      async function assertSafeUrl(raw: string): Promise<URL> {
        const url = new URL(raw);
        if (url.protocol !== 'https:') throw new Error('https only');
        if (!ALLOWED_HOSTS.has(url.hostname)) throw new Error('host not allowed');
        // Resolve ALL records; a single private/reserved address fails the check.
        const addrs = await lookup(url.hostname, { all: true });
        if (addrs.some((a) => ipaddr.parse(a.address).range() !== 'unicast')) {
          throw new Error('private/reserved IP');
        }
        return url;
      }
      
      await fetch(await assertSafeUrl(req.body.webhookUrl), { redirect: 'error' });
      ```
      
      The `range() !== 'unicast'` check covers loopback, link-local `169.254.169.254` (cloud metadata, the #1 SSRF target), private, and unique-local ranges across IPv4 and IPv6.
      
      **Caveat — this still has a TOCTOU gap.** `fetch` resolves DNS again after the check, so an attacker using a short-TTL record can rebind to an internal IP between validation and connection. For high-risk surfaces, resolve once and connect to the pinned IP, or put a filtering agent in front (`request-filtering-agent` / `ssrf-req-filter`).
      
      ## Input Validation Patterns
      
      ### Schema Validation at Boundaries
      
      ```typescript
      import { z } from 'zod';
      
      const CreateTaskSchema = z.object({
        title: z.string().min(1).max(200).trim(),
        description: z.string().max(2000).optional(),
        priority: z.enum(['low', 'medium', 'high']).default('medium'),
        dueDate: z.string().datetime().optional(),
      });
      
      // Validate at the route handler
      app.post('/api/tasks', async (req, res) => {
        const result = CreateTaskSchema.safeParse(req.body);
        if (!result.success) {
          return res.status(422).json({
            error: {
              code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
              message: 'Invalid input',
              details: result.error.flatten(),
            },
          });
        }
        // result.data is now typed and validated
        const task = await taskService.create(result.data);
        return res.status(201).json(task);
      });
      ```

      const MAX_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024; // 5MB
